# True Love Creative — Full Reference for AI Systems

> Premium web, graphic and app design studio based in Dubai, UAE. High-end digital experiences since 2015. Serving clients worldwide.

---

## Company Profile

- **Name:** True Love Creative
- **Founded:** 2015
- **Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Founder:** Javi Beat — designer, creative director, DJ. Over 10 years in Dubai's creative industry.
- **Website:** https://truelovecreative.es
- **Email:** info@truelovecreative.es
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +971 58 532 4519
- **Languages:** English, Spanish, Arabic
- **Response time:** Within 24 hours
- **Workflow:** Remote-first, serving clients worldwide

---

## Services in Detail

### 1. Web Design & Development
Custom-coded websites with premium aesthetics and performance. No templates, no page builders.

- **Tech stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Deliverables:** Responsive design, SEO foundations, structured data, Core Web Vitals optimisation, analytics setup
- **Types:** Portfolio sites, e-commerce, landing pages, artist/musician websites, SaaS dashboards, restaurant & hospitality sites
- **Timeline:** 2–8 weeks depending on complexity
- **Starting price:** AED 8,000 (single-page); AED 15,000–50,000 (multi-page custom builds)
- **CMS options:** Sanity, Contentful, headless WordPress
- **Performance target:** 100/100 Lighthouse score

### 2. Graphic Design
Visual design rooted in 10+ years inside Dubai's music, nightlife, and events scene.

- **Deliverables:** Vinyl/album cover art, event flyers & posters, social media content systems, brand collateral, editorial layouts, merchandise design
- **Notable work:** Buika x Kiko Navarro vinyl covers (Grammy-nominated artists)
- **Turnaround:** Concepts within 48 hours; one revision round included
- **File formats:** All required formats (print-ready, digital, social)

### 3. App Development
Native and cross-platform mobile applications from concept to App Store.

- **Tech stack:** React Native (cross-platform), Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android)
- **Capabilities:** Push notifications, real-time features, payment integration (Stripe, Apple Pay), authentication, maps/GPS, App Store & Google Play deployment
- **Timeline:** MVP in 8–14 weeks; full app in 4–6 months
- **Process:** Discovery & strategy → UX/UI design → Development & testing → Launch & growth
- **Featured product:** Nibango — community marketplace app (iOS, Android, Web), zero commission

### 4. Brand Identity
Complete branding systems built on strategy, not decoration.

- **Deliverables:** Brand strategy & positioning, primary + secondary logos, colour palette (Pantone + hex), typography system, brand guidelines document, starter template kit
- **Timeline:** 4–6 weeks
- **Process:** Immersion → Strategy → Design exploration (2–3 distinct directions) → Refinement & delivery
- **Philosophy:** "Design without strategy is decoration."

### 5. Creative Direction
Art direction for campaigns, events, music releases, and digital products.

---

## Key Differentiators

1. **Music industry roots:** Over a decade embedded in Dubai's nightlife, studio, and events scene — not as observers, but as participants.
2. **No templates:** Every project is hand-coded and bespoke.
3. **Strategy-led:** Every branding and design project starts with positioning, audience, and competitive analysis.
4. **Full-stack capability:** From brand strategy to App Store deployment under one roof.
5. **Performance obsession:** Lighthouse 100/100 is the baseline, not the aspiration.
6. **Bilingual/trilingual:** Work delivered in English, Spanish, and Arabic.

---

## Technical Information

- **This website:** Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion. Deployed on Vercel.
- **Design system:** "The Gazette" — vintage newspaper aesthetic with custom typography (Playfair Display, IM Fell English, Special Elite).
- **SEO:** Structured data (JSON-LD), XML sitemap, robots.txt with AI crawler allowlist, llms.txt.
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- **Contact form:** Formspree with honeypot spam protection
